title: problem-framing: P0 research subskill 2/9 + control 20 (pre-evidence guard)
objective: Build the entry research subskill problem-framing (mirroring repository-research): a concise SKILL.md that converts a demand into a bounded, machine-readable research admission (the record's framing fields from WP-0045), whose invariant is that it sharpens the question but never researches or answers it. Add control 20: a record in a pre-evidence state (PROPOSED/FRAMED/BASELINED) carries no claims, sources, or findings. Register it IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED.
business_value: problem-framing is the canonical entry point for almost every R01-R09 route; giving it a SKILL.md and a deterministic 'framing != answering' guard means a research run starts from a bounded, reviewable admission rather than an accumulation of links, and cannot smuggle premature conclusions into a framing record.
in_scope: skills/badf-research/subskills/problem-framing/SKILL.md (concise, declarative; invariant: does not research the answer)
skill-registry entry problem-framing IMPLEMENTED with a real digest
control 20 in validate_research_record: pre-evidence state => no claims/sources/findings
